ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of Minnesota Welfare Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of the Minnesota welfare fraud scandal and follow the money to see where it leads.
questions: How much money was actually stolen?
Who else was involved in the scandal?
searches: Ringleader of $250M Minnesota welfare fraud scandal
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover a much larger scandal, and I would like to investigate further to see where the money leads.
